truth (Δ1): a save requested from another part of the module (Sys.getStation().save() in -rt) counts: the rule
asks whether any path in the module saves, not where.

package com.x.ux;
final class Writer {
  static void write(BComponent point, BValue v, Context cx) {
    point.set("out", v, cx);
  }
}
-- Mod/Mod-rt/src/com/x/BSaver.java --
package com.x;

}
